reason: The price is nothing and the disputed-frame problem is real, but it is not my signature on the subscription and my floor staff will not touch new software on a busy Tuesday. They will go back to the whiteboard the first time the screen lags and I will be paying for something nobody opens.
objection: My boys on the floor will not learn it. I have seen software die here before because the staff quietly stopped using it, and then I am the one explaining a bill for an app we do not open.
would_change_my_mind: If you set up the first night yourself, in my venue, and showed one of my floor staff running the bracket end to end without me standing over him, I would take it to the owner the same week.
